FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF PHYSICS
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH-160 014 (INDIA)
Phone: ++91-172-2541741
Email: physics@pu.ac.in
D-PHS_______________ Dated: __________
ADVERSTISEMENT
Applications are invited for the following position in a DST- SERB (Govt. of India) sponsored research
project entitled “Multi-Particle Configration and DSAM Lifetime Measurements In Some Proton
Rich Nuclei in A-160 Mass Region” under the following terms and conditions:
Position: JUNIOR RESEARCH FELLOW - (One)
Stipend: Rs. 37000/- (Fixed) Per Month.
Essential Qualification: M. Sc. in Physics/polymer science or equivalent with at least 55% marks
(50% for Candidates belonging to SC/ST Category) with CSIR/UGC-
NET/GATE/Panjab University Ph. D entrance test.
Terms & Conditions:
i) Upper age limit not exceeding 28 years as on the date of interview. Age relaxation up to 5 years
for SC/ST /PWD/OBC (Non-creamy layer applicants) and women candidates as per the Govt. of
India instructions.
ii) This position is purely temporary on contract basis and co-terminus with the sponsored project.
iii) No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
iv) Interested candidates can send their application, along with complete Biodata with contact details
and attested copies of certificates of examination passed (Starting from matriculation indicating
date of birth), one latest photograph, caste certificate in case of SC/ST/OBC and the proof of CSIR,
UGC-NET qualification to the undersigned.
v) The date of interview will be informed on the E-mail ID of the eligible applicants after the last date
of receiving of applications.
vi) For further enquiry, Contact the undersigned on his Email ID: ssihotra@pu.ac.in
Last Date :- 04/03/2024
(Prof. Samarjit Sihotra)
Principal investigator
